C0649.title: Ride-hailing driver detained for prolonged harassment after rejected advances
C0649.summary: A ride-hailing driver subjected a victim to persistent harassment through repeated phone calls, private message bombardment, and uninvited home visits after his romantic advances were rejected. Zhuzhou police imposed an administrative detention penalty and prohibited the individual from contacting the victim for six months.

references.title: Ride-Hailing Driver Detained for Persistent Harassment; Zhuzhou Police Issue Six-Month No-Contact Order
